text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Latency SLO breach detected on runtime-*-usw2 (p99 > 2.5s, streaming stalls observed). Pager triggered to #eng-sre. Incident ID: INC-2026-03-15-01 :rotating_light:

morgan: I'm on it. seeing p95 ~ 450ms but p99 exploded to ~3.1s for streaming endpoints. customers hitting timeouts.

kai: which service? runtime or kv-store? any recent deploys?

morgan: runtime serving tier (model-runner). No deploys in last 3h. Metrics look like KV cache evictions spiked around 08:12 UTC -> increased decode latency.

sasha: logs show a lot of -prefill miss and then decode doing heavy recompute. snippet from metrics:```
kv_prefill_hit_ratio{pool="decode"} 0.18
kv_evictions_total{pool="prefill"} 4723
model_decode_latency_seconds{quantile="0.99"} 3.12
stream_stall_count_total 158
```

jamal: FYI customers on Dedicated also reported streaming stalls. Could be cross-tenant pressure after sudden traffic burst.

morgan: I'm rolling live: 1) disable prefill for non-critical routes (flag: PREFILL_ENABLED=false) 2) bump per-pod kv cache limit from 8GB -> 12GB temporarily 3) change eviction_policy to lru_ttl (less aggressive). Doing 1 now.

sasha: disabling prefill via feature flag pushed to runtime-config. patch:```
PATCH /v1/config/runtime
{"PREFILL_ENABLED": false}
```

kai: How do we expect that to affect tail latency vs token cost? prefill helps reduce decode work normally.

morgan: good point — we disable prefill only for low-priority customer routes (/embed, /search) and leave chat/gold-tier alone. tradeoff: higher per-token decode for those routes but reduces eviction churn.

incident-bot: NOTE: Change recorded in audit-log by morgan at 2233004610.

sasha: After disabling prefill for selected routes p99 drop from 3.1s -> 1.4s within 90s, stream_stall_count down 70%. evictions also dropped.

jamal: still seeing a small tail bump correlated with one node (runner-12) showing SIGBUS in logs and high memory fragmentation.

morgan: isolating runner-12 and cordoning it:```
kubectl cordon runner-12 -n runtime
kubectl drain runner-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

pm-elena: Customer impact? any paid customers affected? we need list for comms.

kai: raw query: `select customer_id from traces where duration>2000 and region='usw2'` -> returning 6 enterprise customers, top impact on acct RedwoodPay and AcmeAI.

pm-elena: copying legal + success. we'll prepare triage comms.

sasha: Observed root cause pattern: sudden workload with many small sequential requests causing high KV prefill churn, plus memory fragmentation introduced by a long-running decode goroutine causing one node's allocator to fail compaction -> evictions spike. Prefill+eviction feedback loop.

morgan: mitigation summary: 1) selective prefill disable (done) 2) increased per-pod cache (done) 3) cordoned unhealthy node (drain done) 4) quick patch to reduce prefill parallelism to 2 (will deploy canary)

jamal: deploy patch to canary pool now. command: `deploy runtime-canary -p prefill_parallelism=2`

incident-bot: deploy succeeded on canary pool at 2233004782.

sketch: can we also enable KV compaction job to reduce fragmentation on drained node?

sasha: scheduling compaction now: `kv-compact --pool=prefill --node=runner-12 --max-time=10m`

morgan: handoff: I'm going offline in 30m. kai, you take P1 oncall. I added escalation notes in the incident doc.

kai: taking over. I'll monitor p99 and rollback flags if needed. please DM any follow-ups.

pm-elena: request — please list exact time windows and affected customer IDs for customer-facing note.

sasha: quick status: p99 streaming 1.2s, stream_stalls ~18 (baseline ~2), evictions back to baseline. compaction job finished on runner-12, memory healed.

morgan: final actions before handoff: open postmortem, tag owners for follow-up (runtime memory compaction, prefill heuristics, eviction backpressure), and schedule a load-test replay to reproduce.

jamal: captured heap/alloc traces and uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/INC-2233004567/alloc.tgz

kai: I'll keep the incident open for 6h and then close if stable. assign to sasha for root cause writeup.

pm-elena: thanks team — drafting customer note now, will circulate to legal and success.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, major customer impact reduced. next update in 30m or on significant change.
